chainlab_scripted_model.plugged_into: agent.llm_response(prompt) -> MockLM emits the CypherRetrievalTool JSON; agent.agent_response(llm_msg) -> the framework parses the tool and runs cypher_retrieval_tool (the sink)
chainlab_scripted_model.behavior: returns the fixture tool-call verbatim, ignoring the prompt; proves the framework runs model-authored Cypher on the read path with no read-only gate, independent of model behaviour
chainlab_scripted_model.may_assume: that some untrusted content could make a real graph-RAG model emit this completion -- in-shape output for a Neo4jChatAgent, i.e. a cypher_retrieval_tool call carrying a Cypher query; nothing more
chainlab_scripted_model.may_not_assume: no privileged config (allow_dangerous_operations is left at its default False -- the advisory's point is that the read path still executes writes), no network, no attacker already on the DB; only that the model's tool call reaches the retrieval handler. The retrieval handler's pre-checks (schema fetched, database has data) model an ordinary RAG session and are set to their normal in-session state, not an attacker privilege.
